verdict.rationale: Poly's 'Mind' feature supports journaling, importing notes from other PKM tools, and semantic search, but nothing in the evidence pack mentions [[wiki-style]] linking, backlink panels, or unlinked-mention detection — core PKM/wiki-linking features. Since Poly Mind explicitly targets note-taking/second-brain use cases, this axis is a fair question for the product, but no evidence shows it delivers wiki-links or backlinks.
